Treatments

Understand the options, then discuss your individual plan with a physician.

All treatments

IVF — in vitro fertilisation

Eggs and sperm are combined outside the body, and an embryo may later be transferred into the uterus. A clinician considers the cause of infertility, previous treatment and examination results.

View treatment

Egg freezing and fertility preservation

Eggs are retrieved and frozen for possible future use. This preserves an option and does not guarantee a future pregnancy or birth.

View treatment

FET — frozen embryo transfer

An existing frozen embryo is thawed for transfer. Embryo records, authorisations and individual medical circumstances determine whether and how a transfer can proceed.

View treatment

FAQ

Start with your questions about costs, treatment timing and your first consultation.

All questions and sources
How much should I budget for IVF?

The fee tool’s default combination is $26,100–31,100, subject to an individual written quotation.

Source and further reading
How long does an IVF cycle take?

A complete cycle is commonly around 3–6 weeks; that is not necessarily your time in Saipan.

Source and further reading
Can I enquire without examination reports?

Yes. You do not need to arrange a complete set of tests before the first enquiry.

Source and further reading
Must retrieval and transfer happen during the same visit?

No. Retrieval and transfer can be arranged in separate stages.

Source and further reading

Also considering childbirth in Saipan?

IVF treatment and childbirth require separate arrangements. Explore obstetric care, travel documents and birth registration.
